common_test: record_uid intersection, source_exact order; all source metadata/labels/structures equal; disjoint UID, canonical smiles and document from BOTH ORIGINAL train pools; stop on failure, never substitute UID schema
training_budget: min(original source row count, original temporal row count), context rows not distinct molecules
sampling: For each target/pool/draw independently instantiate np.random.RandomState(drawseed); sort(choice(N,size=m,replace=False)); take iloc in stable original order. If N=m retain whole pool.
reuse: Both FULL references and every matched pool with N=m reuse exact frozen predictions sliced to common test. No full-pool refits/index builds. Empty tests retained, all metrics blank and no new fit.
rf: Original model_config.json rf, change only n_jobs=2 and random_state to fixed seeds; fresh once per exact ordered training signature/model/config
nn: binary Morgan Tanimoto, first maximum in ordered sample, zero union similarity=1, no labels in neighbour selection
primary: Absolute model MSE; mean squared row loss separately per RF seed THEN median across RF seeds
fixed_reference: common-test variance: constant equals common-test mean, descriptive oracle normalization only; normalized_mse=MSE/variance and oracle_skill=1-MSE/variance; blank if variance=0
baseline: Each arm uses its own training mean; training_mean_skill=1-MSE/mean((test_y-train_mean)^2); blank if baseline=0
identity: full_gap=year_size+matched_pool+source_size, per draw, absolute tolerance 1e-12; median components need not add
aggregation: Per target/model median across five per-draw metrics and contrasts; retain min/max labelled sampling range, not confidence intervals. All 11 targets and 3 models retained.
diagnostics: Both matched pools each draw: maximum test-to-train Tanimoto median and >=0.8 fraction, distinct smiles/documents, population mean/std labels and document_year. No selection or matching on these.
parsing: pandas default original source CSV; round_trip archived/new predictions and prepared/analysis CSV
limitation: Residual matched-size pool differences may reflect label, time, document and composition differences and cannot be interpreted as a pure structural effect.
population: Inference describes only the frozen common-test intersection, not the full original held-out population.
restart: Exclusive PID RUNNING.lock; incomplete fit ledger or unledgered model/prediction stops for diagnosis. Resume only completed hash-bound jobs. Never repeat uncertain fits.
